shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- nested agents ---'; find . -path './node_modules' -prune -o -name AGENTS.md -print"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- app files ---'; for f in app/*.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json AGENTS.md; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done; printf '"'%s\\n' '--- relevant docs ---'; find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | rg -i 'partial|prerender|cache-components|loading|suspense' | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- migrating cache components ---'; sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- loading convention ---'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- cache components references ---'; find node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -type f -print0 | xargs -0 rg -l \"cacheComponents|Partial Prerender|prerender shell|Suspense\" | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- cache components config ---'; sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- instant navigation ---'; sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- data fetching suspense/cache excerpts ---'; rg -n -C 5 \"Suspense|use cache|uncached\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md | sed -n '1,360p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '260,525p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- instant key sections ---'; rg -n \""'^## |''^### |Suspense|loading'"\\.tsx|static shell|fallback|uncached\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md | sed -n '1,260p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- use cache directive ---'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short; printf '%s\\n' '--- build artifacts ---'; find .next/server/app -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- prerender route metadata ---'; cat .next/prerender-manifest.json | sed -n '1,240p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- tsconfig diff ---'; git diff -- tsconfig.json"
